ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung SSD 860 EVO 4TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-76E4T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am organizing my computer setup, but I have no current need for a large internal drive.

ItemID: NA; Title: Kingston 1.92TB A400 SATA 3 2.5" Internal SSD SA400S37/1920G - HDD Replacement for Increase Performance; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases suggest accessory and connectivity needs, without a specific internal storage upgrade planned.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my display setup interests, but I would skip it until I need more reach than my existing HDMI cable provides.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Short cables could tidy nearby connections, but I just picked up Ethernet cables and have not established a need for six more.
ItemID: NA; Title: TP-Link 24 Port Gigabit Ethernet Switch | Desktop/ Rackmount | Limited Lifetime Protection | Plug & Play | Shielded Ports | Sturdy Metal | Fanless Quiet | Traffic Optimization | Unmanaged (TL-SG1024S); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Wired networking interests me, but 24 ports exceed what I currently expect to connect.
ItemID: NA; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for experimenting with another Raspberry Pi setup; the reader would make preparing cards convenient, subject to compatibility.
ItemID: NA; Title: Samsung BAR Plus 64GB - 300MB/s USB 3.1 Flash Drive Champagne Silver (MUF-64BE3/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this as a convenient way to move setup files between computers while working on my devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 10 Port 60W USB 3.0 Hub with Individual Power Switches and LEDs Includes 60W 12V/5A Power Adapter (HB-BU10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A powered hub suits my peripheral use, but I would check my actual port shortage before adding a ten-port unit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics 2-Pack USB-A 3.0 Extension Cable, 4.8Gbps High-Speed, Male to Female Gold-Plated Connectors, 6 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to bring USB connections within reach while keeping cables routed neatly around my desk.
